title: Toward Effective and Reliable LLM Agents via Dynamic Ontology
abstract: arXiv:2608.22974v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely heavily on knowledge encoded in model parameters or presented as unstructured context. In domain-specific tasks, this leaves important semantic connections implicit. This often results in incomplete evidence use and brittle multi-step decisions. Ontologies offer a way to externalize domain concepts and relations as machine-interpretable structures, but constructing task-usable ontologies traditionally requires substantial effort from domain experts and is difficult to scale. Automatic construction is also challenging: an ontology that appears semantically plausible may not contain the relational structures needed for actual decision making. We present OaK, an ontology-as-a-kernel framework that dynamically constructs and refines task-oriented ontologies for LLM agents. translated_title: 面向有效且可靠的LLM智能体：基于动态本体论
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体严重依赖于模型参数中编码的知识或作为非结构化上下文呈现的信息。在特定领域任务中，这导致重要的语义联系被隐含，往往造成证据使用不完整和多步决策脆弱。本体论提供了一种将领域概念和关系外部化为机器可解释结构的方法，但传统上构建可用于任务的本体需要领域专家的大量投入，且难以扩展。自动构建也面临挑战：一个看似语义合理的本体可能不包含实际决策所需的关联结构。我们提出了OaK，一个本体即内核框架，用于动态构建和细化面向任务的LLM智能体本体。给定任务需求和训练数据，OaK构建本体及其知识图谱，并生成任务自适应函数f。
tldr: 本文提出OaK框架，通过动态构建和细化面向任务的本体，增强LLM智能体在领域任务中的证据使用和决策可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OaK, a framework that dynamically constructs and refines task-oriented ontologies to enhance evidence use and decision reliability of LLM agents in domain tasks.
